```yaml
name: SDK CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['*']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  validate-version:
    name: Validate tag matches pyproject.toml version
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install hatch
        run: pip install hatch

      - name: Get version from pyproject.toml
        id: get_version
        run: |
          echo "VERSION=$(hatch version)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Check tag matches version
        run: |
          TAG=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}
          if [ "$TAG" != "${{ steps.get_version.outputs.VERSION }}" ]; then
            echo "❌ Tag $TAG does not match version ${{ steps.get_version.outputs.VERSION }}"
            exit 1
          fi

  sdk-generate:
    name: Validate SDK generation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install hatch
        run: pip install hatch

      - name: Generate SDK
        run: uv run hatch run server:sdk-generate

  python-publish:
    name: Publish Python package
    needs: validate-version
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: pypi
      url: https://pypi.org/p/run-llama
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install hatch
        run: pip install hatch

      - name: Publish to PyPI
        env:
          HATCH_INDEX_USER: __token__
          HATCH_INDEX_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PYPI_TOKEN }}
        run: hatch publish

  typescript-publish:
    name: Publish TypeScript SDK
    needs: validate-version
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: npm
      url: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@llamaindex/workflows-client
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build SDK
        run: pnpm run build

      - name: Publish to npm
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: pnpm publish --access public
```
